criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, often notable for their achievements or roles.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture or movie, typically a narrative work of fiction.

categories.name: Musical Work
categories.definition: A composition or album of music, including songs and performances.

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism that belongs to the kingdom Plantae, including trees, shrubs, and flowers.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism that belongs to the kingdom Animalia, including mammals, birds, and insects.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural physical feature of the Earth, such as mountains, rivers, and lakes.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A constructed physical structure, typically for human use or habitation.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A group of people organized for a particular purpose, such as a company, institution, or non-profit.

categories.name: Historical Event
categories.definition: A significant occurrence in history that has lasting impact or importance.

categories.name: Journal
categories.definition: A periodical publication that contains scholarly articles and research findings.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transporting people or goods, including cars, ships, and aircraft.

categories.name: Literary Work
categories.definition: A written work, such as a novel, poem, or essay, that is considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

categories.name: Political Entity
categories.definition: An organization or group that holds political power or influence, such as a government or political party.

categories.name: Scientific Publication
categories.definition: A document that presents original research findings or reviews in a scientific field.

categories.name: Cultural Artifact
categories.definition: An object made by humans that reflects the culture or society of its time.
